d:
Bihar ko jald hi 'nitish setu' ki bari saugat milne ja rahi hai. is pul ke shuru hone se aavagman aasan hone ke sath-sath aaspas ke ilakon men kanektiviti, vyapar, rojgar aur vikas ko naee raphtar milne ki ummid hai. aakhir nitish setu se logon ko kaun-kaun se 10 bare phayde milenge aur kaise badlegi ilake ki tasvir?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
